name: Wentworth-Gardner House

dates.note: The Wikipedia infobox and article both give 1760. The address is printed two ways on the same page -- '140 Mechanic Street' in the infobox, '50 Mechanic Street' in the article's first sentence -- which is why the exemplar's location stops at the town.

refs.title: NRHP reference No. 68000012; added November 24, 1968; designated NHL November 24, 1968; contributing to 'Wentworth-Gardner and Tobias Lear Houses' (ID79000319) (as the Wikipedia infobox prints it)
Wentworth-Gardner House | National Trust for Historic Preservation
refs.note: The Trust's page: built 'as a wedding gift for Thomas Wentworth and his bride, Anne Tasker'; 'the heavy carving and exquisite detail of the formal parlor, parlor chamber, and traditional hallway, which extends the entire depth of the house'.

note: Written 4 Sep 2026 from the WP-11.1 research pass; a new exemplar on new-england-georgian. No HABS record was found: the query '"Wentworth-Gardner House" Mechanic Street Portsmouth NH HABS' on loc.gov returned other Portsmouth houses, and an open search returned only the Trust's and the association's pages.
